mapper.update: update inquiry set user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR}, inquiry_type = #{inquiryType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, phone_num = #{phoneNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, user_name = #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, answer_user_name = #{answerUserName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, create_time = #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, answer_time = #{answerTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, processed_flg = #{processedFlg,jdbcType=TINYINT}, delete_flg = #{deleteFlg,jdbcType=TINYINT}, inquiry_contents = #{inquiryContents,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, answer_contents = #{answerContents,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} where inquiry_id = #{inquiryId,jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.select: select inquiry_id, user_id, inquiry_type, phone_num, user_name, answer_user_name, create_time, answer_time, processed_flg, delete_flg, inquiry_contents, answer_contents from inquiry where inquiry_id = #{inquiryId,jdbcType=CHAR}

select inquiry_id, user_id, inquiry_type, phone_num, user_name, answer_user_name, create_time, answer_time, processed_flg, delete_flg, inquiry_contents, answer_contents from inquiry where coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0 order by create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into inquiry (inquiry_id, user_id, inquiry_type, phone_num, inquiry_contents, user_name, create_time) values (#{inquiryId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{inquiryType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phoneNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{inquiryContents,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR))
mapper.select: select count(*) from inquiry where coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0 and coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 0

select inquiry_id, user_id, inquiry_type, phone_num, user_name, answer_user_name, create_time, answer_time, processed_flg, delete_flg, inquiry_contents, answer_contents from inquiry where coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0 and coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 0 order by create_time desc limit 1

select inquiry_id, user_id, inquiry_type, phone_num, user_name, answer_user_name, create_time, answer_time, processed_flg, delete_flg, inquiry_contents, answer_contents from inquiry where user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=CHAR} and coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0 order by create_time desc

select inquiry_id as inquiryId, user_id as userId, case inquiry_type when 'password_reset' then '비밀번호 재발급' when 'account' then '계정/권한 문의' when 'task_report' then '작업배정/현장보고' when 'bug' then '오류/버그 신고' when 'feature' then '기능개선 제안' when 'general' then '일반/기타 문의' else coalesce(inquiry_type, '일반문의') end as inquiryType, phone_num as phoneNum, user_name as userName, answer_user_name as answerUserName, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createTime, date_format(answer_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as answerTime, processed_flg as processedFlg, case when coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 1 then '답변완료' else '답변대기' end as statusText, delete_flg as deleteFlg, inquiry_contents as inquiryContents, answer_contents as answerContents from inquiry where coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0
and coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 1
and coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 0
and inquiry_type = #{inquiryType}
and create_time >= concat(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and create_time <= concat(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
and ( user_name like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or user_id like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or phone_num like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or inquiry_contents like concat('%', #{query}, '%') )
order by create_time desc
limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from inquiry where coalesce(delete_flg, 0) = 0
and coalesce(processed_flg, 0) = 1

and inquiry_type = #{inquiryType}

and ( user_name like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or user_id like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or phone_num like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or inquiry_contents like concat('%', #{query}, '%') )
